_about: From the old Wix site's list pages /student-ccas/ocips, /lcips and /clubs (2026-11-16): each card's colour (the card background), the two pictures on it (media ids; which is the logo and which the header varies) and its caption. Keys are the names used in records.bodies.

Project Aasha.caption: Project Aasha aims to create sustainable impact and serve rural communities in Nepal through surgical, community health, and education initatives.

Project Asada.caption: Project Asada's main beneficiary is Baan Eurphon Orphanage in Thailand. We help foster a healthy, clean and nurturing environment for these children to develop and grow.

Project Bantayan.caption: Project Bantayan aims to serve the underprivileged communities of Bantayan, an island North of Cebu province. The main aim is to raise health literacy and accessibility on Bantayan Island sustainably.

Project Butanding.caption: Founded in 2024, Project Butanding is among LKCMedicine's newest OCIPs working in Leyte, Philippines. Together with local partners, we organise health initiatives to improve community health outcomes.

Project Chiang Mai.caption: Providing health screenings and education in Phrao, Thailand, in partnership with local organizations to address prevalent medical conditions and improve community health.

Project Davao.caption: OCIP Davao serves the Langub and Gumalang villages in Davao City, Philippines, to address their long-term health needs and build long-lasting relationships.

Project Daya.caption: Project Daya is the longest-running OCIP in LKCMedicine. We aim to empower locals in Kampung Air (KA) and Kampung Puggur (KP), Batam, Indonesia, allowing them to independently take care of their health.

Project Iloilo.caption: Project Iloilo is the newest OCIP on the block! We serve the local community in Iloilo, Philippines, playing our part in delivering increased accessibility to healthcare.

Project ISIP.caption: Project ISIP was established in 2017 with the ongoing aim to provide health screenings and education to rural communities in Bacolod City, Philippines.

Project Karuna.caption: Project Karuna is an OCIP focused on improving the health of Soliga tribal communities in Biligiriranga (BR) Hills, Karnataka, India.

Project Kolkata.caption: Established in 2018, we work to empower those affected by the sex-trafficking trade in Kolkata, India, where the largest red light district in Asia is located.

Project Songkeum.caption: Project Songkeum has been running programmes devoted to increasing the health literacy of the villagers in Cambodia since 2015.

Project Tongxin.caption: Project Tongxin was founded in 2024 as an OCIP aiming to provide aid in the rural areas of the Qinghai province, specifically addressing healthcare issues related to the high altitude.

Active Ageing Advocates.caption: Active Ageing Advocates (AAA) focuses on preventive medicine and behavourial change to enhance the wellbeing of our seniors.

Blood Donation Drive.caption: LKC BDD collaborates with the Singapore Red Cross Society and the Health Sciences Authority to organize blood donation drives at the Clinical Sciences Building.

Camp Simba.caption: Camp Simba hopes to serve as a platform to provide a safe and conducive environment for children, whose relatives are afflicted with cancer, to have fun.

Constructing Care Collaboration.caption: Constructing Care Collaboration (CCC) is a student-initiated group with the goal of improving the understanding and care of migrant workers amongst future healthcare professionals.

Dover Park Hospice.caption: Dover Park Hospice (DPH) is a non-profit organisation that provides palliative care to individuals. The Tanzanite group is primary involved with befriending the residents of the hospice.

Make-A-Wish.caption: Make A Wish LKC was established in 2022, and is a partnership with Make-A-Wish Singapore to raise awareness about Make-A-Wish among the medical community and to grant wishes to children with critical illnesses.

Medisign.caption: Project MediSign aims to bridge this gap between members of the Deaf community and healthcare providers, and improve healthcare awareness and information accessibility in the Deaf Community.

NHG-LKC CommHealth.caption: In liaison with various partners within NHG to support student volunteerism in initiatives that bridge the gap between healthcare services and the population.

Neighbourhood Health Service.caption: A collaboration between students from LKCMedicine and NUS Medicine among others, aiming to provide underserved rental block residents with access to healthcare.

Pallipals.caption: Pallipals is a palliative care initiative where our volunteers dedicate time and heart to bringing comfort, companionship, and creative joy to elderly residents in hospice care.

Project Angel.caption: Project Angel is a group of passionate medical students who serve members with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

Project Envision.caption: Project Envision collaborates with the Singapore Association of the Visually Handicapped (SAVH) to support individuals with visual impairments through inclusive community initiatives.

Project Janan.caption: Project Janan works with Ronald McDonald House Charities to improve the experience of ill children during their hospital stay in National University Hospital (NUH) and Institute of Mental Health (IMH)

Project Kirakira.caption: Project Kirakira aims to raise awareness and address the gaps in the care for sexual assault victims in Singapore.

Project LKCaleidoscope.caption: Project LKCaleidoscope aims to meet the emotional needs of palliative care patients and their family as they journey through the difficult end-of-life journey through photos and videos.

Project Prism.caption: Project Prism aims to educate medical students on how to best support LGBTQ+ patients in their future work, to ultimately improve outcomes and accessibility in queer healthcare.

Project Soleil.caption: Project Soleil aims to raise awareness on Motor Neurone Diseases (MNDs), and serve afflicted communities within Singapore.

SGMarrow.caption: AMSA SGMarrow works with the Bone Marrow Donor Programme (BMDP) to increase the chances for patients with blood-related diseases who require a Bone Marrow Donation (BMD) to find a viable match.

Savepoint.caption: Savepoint works with Singapore's Children Society to host an annual health education camp for children and youth from vulnerable backgrounds all over Singapore.

Teddy Bear Hospital.caption: Teddy Bear Hospital is an educational outreach project organised by NUS and NTU medical students, with the support of National University Hospital Singapore.

The Final Journey Collective.caption: The Final Journey Collective partners with Cheng Hong AMS to give medical students meaningful service-learning experiences honouring individuals who pass away without family or support.

Trigenerational Homecare.caption: We hope that every elderly in Singapore is able to experience the protection, care and love of a family! As healthcare students, we aim to serve the medical, psychological and social needs of elderly

LKCrew.caption: LKCMedicine's Dance Crew. We’re a student interest group established in 2019 with the aim of fostering a stronger dance culture in LKC through weekly dance sessions and performances.

MedLee.caption: Medlee is a student-led acapella group brought together by our members’ shared love for music and performing.
